pills.label: From €85
pills.pop_html: Three towns in one day: Visegrád's royal castle, Esztergom's basilica and the artists' village of Szentendre.Lunch is extra; the Visegrád Castle ticket is included.

pills.label: Visegrád Castle ticket
pills.pop_html: Visegrád Castle entry is included, with an air-conditioned coach and a live guide. Lunch and tips are extra.

pills.label: Boat back in summer
pills.pop_html: May to September (Thursday to Sunday) you return by boat; otherwise, or when the water is too high or low, by coach.

pills.label: Esztergom Basilica
pills.pop_html: Hungary's largest cathedral and the Renaissance Bakócz Chapel, plus a Danube viewpoint towards Slovakia.

pills.label: Long, easy day
pills.pop_html: 9 hours: about 6 at the stops and 3 on the road. Three towns without planning a thing.

pills.label: North of Budapest
pills.pop_html: From May to September, Thursday to Sunday, you return by boat; otherwise by coach.

best_for.pick_html: if you have 4 days or more: the river bends between castle hills, and the summer boat back is a cruise in itself.
best_for.skip_html: on a 2 or 3-day trip, when the city has more than enough to fill your days.
